summary.text: In a November 2026 post, FBI Director Kash Patel said the FBI established an AI Working Group, appointed a Chief AI Officer, and launched an AI Review Board. In September 2026 posts, Patel said he increased FBI AI use by 605% and expanded AI use cases from 2 to 140. Patel also said AI is central to FBI work and, when used lawfully, is a critical tool to triage data.
